name: Domino Fall
description: The first clip is cut into standing slats that topple backward like dominoes in a chain reaction across the frame, each one leaning onto the next and knocking it over, until they all lie flat and reveal the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: reverse
params.description: The chain runs from right to left instead of left to right

params.name: knock
params.description: Part of a slat's fall after which it knocks the next one: lower runs the chain faster, with more slats falling at once

params.name: lean
params.description: How far each slat's top leans sideways onto the next one, as a part of a slat's width

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the slats darken as they fall, and the shadows they cast
